user_prompt: Compare the supplied common-equity and gross-revenue sharing proposals. Separate recipient NPV from sponsor incremental cost, administration and upfront contributions. Show timing, terminal receipts and operating funding gaps. Calculate a purely algebraic revenue fraction matching recipient NPV; never label it tender qualification. Stress revenue, distributable cash, sharing duration and discount rate.
mandate: Use the existing finance role and deterministic tools. Preserve synthetic labels and source snapshot; no assumption of community consent, eligibility or award probability.
input_schema: case.json v1.0: nominal AUD; 1..50 consecutive year-end rows; nonnegative revenue and after-debt/tax distributable cash <= revenue; initial equity, terminal after-debt/tax proceeds; discount/fractions in [0,1]; recipient contributions at year zero; sponsor setup/admin costs; inclusive revenue sharing start/end within horizon.
scheduler_prompt: Delegate evidence before finance. Only registered ready tasks may run. No contact, agreement, submission, payment, trading or physical controls.
evidence_requirements: Reviewed public source snapshot and ISO dates
Explicit financial assumptions and outstanding evidence gaps
Input SHA256; recompute evidence audit at finance handoff
handoffs: Operator supplies synthetic or independently reviewed scenario inputs; this example accepts synthetic classification only
Evidence contract validates snapshot and schema; it cannot authenticate external facts or consent
Finance consumes the case and input-bound audit
Human project finance and First Nations advisers review financial and nonfinancial evidence before any external use
output_contract: Annual recipient operating/exit receipts, admin, sponsor net cash and funding gaps
Recipient NPV and sponsor incremental cost PV in AUD
No-sharing sponsor diagnostic and equity baseline
Revenue fraction at recipient NPV parity, with feasibility flag
No qualification determination; no agreements authorized; unmeasured LLM usage unknown
acceptance: Annual cash conservation including sponsor top-ups
Zero denominator yields null parity fraction
Terminal proceeds excluded from operating funding gap coverage
Deterministic/scripted parity; no invented agent performance
